header.title: Your account.
header.subtitle: Profile, notifications, data and account deletion. All under your own control.

errors.handle_invalid: Handle must start with a letter (a-z) and be 2–31 characters (a-z, 0-9, _, ., -).
errors.handle_taken: That handle is already taken. Try another.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.service_key_missing: Account deletion requires server configuration that is not set up.
errors.prefs_save: Could not save. Please try again.

profile.title: How the crew sees you
profile.bioPlaceholder: What do you lift for? Where are you on your journey?

notifications.title: When we may reach out to you
notifications.pushDescription: A notification on your phone when it is time to log a meal or start a session. Requires you to allow notifications in the browser.
notifications.formCheckLabel: Coach notes on your form checks
notifications.formCheckSub: Email when Mikael has reviewed and written a note.
notifications.mentionSub: Email when a crew member mentions you in a comment.
notifications.digestSub: Monday morning: top PRs, new members, the challenge of the month.
notifications.tierUpSub: When you cross from Lifter → Athlete → Beast → Legend.

data.title: Export your own rows
data.description: Download a JSON file with the member-owned rows we can read under your login: profile, training, journal, mind-check, mental coach, HRV, nutrition, messages, weight, community, Reps and form checks. Not “everything in the universe”, just your own rows. GDPR art. 20.
data.exportNoteConnected: Personal data export from {product}. Contains your own member rows we can read under your login (RLS). Contact {email} if something is missing or looks wrong.
data.exportNoteDemo: Demo mode has no connected database. This file is empty of member rows. Art. 20 export of your real rows requires connected mode.
data.exportOmitted: These tables could not be read in this export: {tables}.

danger.title: Delete your account
danger.description: Permanent and irreversible. All sessions, posts, Reps and form checks are deleted. Any active Stripe subscription must be cancelled separately from the billing page first.
danger.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. All your sessions, posts, Reps and form checks are deleted permanently.

body.title: Body
body.intro: You decide which numbers you see. HQ still plans from them in the background.
body.hideNumbersSub: Food shows meals and protein without calories, and body weight disappears from the app.
body.showWeightCardSub: A 7-day average and the direction. Never a single weigh-in.
body.pejlemaerkeSub: A body weight you set yourself as a direction. HQ never counts down to it or shows the distance.
body.why: HQ uses height, year of birth and sex only to set limits: a direction weight below a healthy weight for your height, and a daily target below what your body uses at rest.

errors.adult: A direction weight and body weight require that you are 18 or older.
errors.invalid: One of the numbers looks wrong. Check height, year of birth and direction weight.
errors.needsHeight: Add your height so HQ can set the limit for the direction weight.
errors.belowHealthy: That direction weight is below a healthy weight for your height, so HQ will not set it. Write to Munk if you want to talk about your direction.
errors.unknown: It could not be saved. Try again.
